reviews.title: Horrendous customer service
reviews.body:
Horrendous customer service. I first called Lebara customer service on the 11th of September to ask to be refunded the money they took out of my top-up balance wrongfully. I had been charged for roaming outside of the EU when I was in Greece the whole time.
On the 11th of September I was told I would get a call back from the complaints team in 24-48 hours. I never got a call back.
I then called again on Friday 25th September. I was again told I would receive a call back by the end of the day.
Low and behold I never received a call.

I then phoned again on Monday 28th September and was told I would get a call back by the end of the day again.
And of course I received no call.

I am at my last tether with this company I cannot get through to anyone to get my money back. They make it impossible to actually sort anything out or even complain!

I had another awful experience with their customer service in August where they managed to swap mine and my father’s phone numbers, resulting in a serious GDPR breech. And trying to rectify it and swap the numbers back was near enough impossible - even though it was their fault.

This company has the worst customer service I have ever received. I do not know how I will ever get through to their complaints department.

DO NOT USE LEBARA if you want your sanity.

reviews.title: Excellent, Knowledgeable and Personalised Customer Service
reviews.body:
I had an excellent experience with Lebara, and I would particularly like to recognise Milad Shaikh for the outstanding customer service he provided.

Milad took the time to understand exactly what I needed rather than simply recommending a standard option. He helped me identify the most appropriate mobile plan for my requirements, advised me on the right type of SIM, and made sure that the solution provided as much flexibility as possible.

What I particularly appreciated was his knowledgeable and helpful approach. He clearly explained the available options, answered my questions and helped me reach a solution that was appropriate for the way I intend to use the service. I never felt rushed or pressured into choosing something that wasn't right for me.

The whole experience was professional, efficient and genuinely customer-focused. Having previously had some difficulty getting the support I needed, the assistance I received from Milad made a very positive difference and demonstrated the standard of service customers should be able to expect.

Thank you, Milad, for your patience, knowledge and excellent support. A very positive experience and well deserving of five stars.

reviews.title: Nine days barred — disgraceful complaint handling despite senior escalation
reviews.body:
Lebara has left me without outgoing calls, texts and mobile data for nine days while I remain unable to use the monthly plan I paid for. Cheap prices mean very little when this is the support you receive after reporting fraud.

I reported unauthorised payments and multiple messages relating to attempts to transfer my number to another SIM. After my bank recovered the disputed payments, Lebara barred my service and told me to reverse the chargeback or pay another £15 before restoration would be considered.

The consequences have been serious. I have been unable to access medical care, missed credit-card payments because I could not telephone my card provider, and been unable to carry out essential caring responsibilities for ill family members. When my disabled mother fell, I could not contact her carers using my barred service. I have also struggled to use maps when travelling to work sites.

I have explained these consequences repeatedly. Yet I am still chasing a resolution.

A representative promised to call me back the same day. That callback never happened. The written replies read like generic templates, repeating that my case has been “escalated” without giving me a clear restoration date or answering my security concerns.

I have escalated my complaint to Stephen Shurrock and John-Paul Patten. That escalation has still not produced a resolution. In my opinion, this is a disgraceful failure of customer service and accountability.

Lebara has referred to its own financial loss. What about the customer’s financial loss, inability to access essential services and time spent chasing unanswered emails?

I still have no clear explanation of what happened to my account, what investigation has been completed or what protections have been put in place. My repeated requests for a deadlock letter remain unanswered, despite Lebara previously describing its position as final.

Please do not respond publicly asking me to email again as though I have not already done so repeatedly. Review the correspondence, assign someone who can resolve the complaint and explain when my service will be restored.

I expect restoration, reimbursement for the paid service I could not use, consideration of my evidenced losses and appropriate compensation. I will update this review when there is meaningful action. Nine days of disruption and broken promises is unacceptable.

reviews.title: The worst company ever!
reviews.body: The worst company ever!! I called them in September 2025 and asked them for a sim for simply one month ONLY just to use data for a relative visiting England. The agent told me I will only be charged for September and assured me of this. I triple checked before hanging up the phone and the agent reassured me every time. I’ve checked my account in June 2026 and saw they’ve charged me from September 2025 till July 2026. I called and explained the situation even though I was reassured I wouldn’t be charged. I called them in July 2026 and they asked for evidence which I sent and the refund was initiated. I was told to wait 5-7 working days to receive it. It is now almost October 2026 and I still haven’t recieved the refund. The reason for this is because everytime I waited 5-7 working days, I would call them to chase my refund and they would say wait another 5-7 days. They have done this from July all the way till now, 27th September 2025, a whole YEAR from when this happened!!! I’ve made multiple complaints and asked for compensation. I was promised both a FULL refund and compensation on top, but still nothing. This company is a joke and they are stealing peoples money. I will not stop until I get my refund. I am expecting £100 refund that I will get whether I need to take them to court or not! Do not use Lebara, the colleagues are useless and it is not worth the headache.

reviews.title: If I could score zero
reviews.body:
If I could score zero , or minus I would 

Do not be fooled by too good to be true promotional deals 

I haven’t been able to use most services since getting my sim , and all of a sudden can’t use anything at all now , I got this for my daughter for starting seniors , she has additional needs, and not having access to data and phone calls is putting her in a very possible unsafe situations

I’ve been paying for a service which for the most part has not been provided, plus have effectively lost out on the benefit of the promotional period (which makes me question is this their intention?)

I reported the issue 2 weeks ago and still nothing , they provide timescales and don’t adhere to them at all 

The staff you get to speak to are shockingly bad, they speak to you very rudely and patronising, they also literally hang up the minute they realise it’s not a straightforward call  , they will also say a manager will call back , and it never happens 

I have worked in customer service for 20 plus years and never known such terrible service on this level 

I have even been left to research what the problem may be, and informed them 
And it’s very possible that all they need to do is send me a replacement sim , as the one they have provided is likely corrupt , or a factory misprint 

Yet how has the company not even attempted this 2 weeks in, and also said they can’t try to initiate trying this simple possible fix, now that a complaint has been logged, never ever heard anything like it 

It’s been so shockingly bad, with no resolution to date, that I will be reporting this to the communications ombudsman 

I’d avoid them at all costs
